text:
Alina (Sales): passing NebulaRx to CS - 220-seat pilot, US-only, private VPC deploy requested + SAML SSO + token-level billing exports. Pilot target week of 2025-09-22. They plan to run synthetic PII during evals and asked for audit logs + future HSM. Also flagged a bulk embedding job (~6M vectors) during pilot. Please own onboarding and call out infra/compliance blockers.

Ben (CS): Thanks Alina. Quick Qs: who is their infra contact and expected concurrency for batch vs interactive? Also any early renewal signals?

Alina (Sales): Contact is Omar (Nebula infra). Batch: ~4-6k qps over ~36h window; interactive: ~40 concurrent users pilot ramping to ~280 over 3 months. Renewal interest: they asked about 12-month commit and stepped discounts.

Ben (CS): Noted. Key risks: private deploy lead time, SSO timing, billing export format, audit log retention/PII handling, and embedding throughput tuning. Tentative owners: Ben (onboarding lead), Rafa (support/runbook), Mira (eng infra), Alina (sales sponsor). I'll open the ticket and schedule kickoff.

sync-bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-8454 "NebulaRx private deploy + SAML + embeddings" assigned to Rafa.

Rafa (Support): Runbook stub in SUP-8454: - Validate SAML metadata exchange - VPC peering CIDR & routing checks - Billing export sample (CSV/JSON) - Audit log retention & redaction rules - Ingest throttles & shard plan for 6M vectors - Provision ETA for dedicated GPUs.

Mira (Eng): Two infra notes: 1) Model family and max seq length change GPU footprint significantly. For 13B gen -> ~2xA40 equiv; 70B -> ~6xA100-80GB equiv. 2) If embeddings + gen run concurrently we may need separate pools or burst configs. Provision lead time region-dependent (7-12 business days). Need model confirmation before provisioning.

Ben (CS): Action items: 1) Kickoff + enablement (owner: Ben) 2) Support ticket + runbook (owner: Rafa -> SUP-8454) 3) Confirm model & seq length with customer (owner: Alina -> Omar) 4) Billing export spec + sample (owner: Ben + Billing Ops) 5) Provision capacity after model confirmed (owner: Mira) 6) Draft 1-page SSO + infra checklist for Omar (owner: Ben).

Alina (Sales): I'll ask Omar to confirm model family, seq length, and embedding vector dims today. Also will capture PO timing for the annual commit.

Rafa (Support): Runbook snippet posted in SUP-8454: ```- Validate IdP/SP metadata exchange
- Confirm cert rotation points and contacts
- Verify VPC peering & route propagation
- Run small ingest smoke (10k vectors) before full batch
- Audit logs: decide metadata-only vs request bodies (PII)```

Mira (Eng): I'll add model/quantization recommendations to SUP-8454 and propose default profiles (cost vs latency). If they confirm 70B float expect ~10 business days to provision equivalent capacity; with 4-bit quant we can reduce servers ~40-50%.

Ben (CS): Scheduling kickoff: 2025-08-19 11:00 PT (Omar + Alina + Rafa + Mira). Invite sent. I'll tag renewal-watch in SFDC and set reminders at 180/120/60 days.

Alina (Sales): One more ask from Omar: a 1-page onboarding checklist for his infra team. Ben can you post that here before EOD?

Rafa (Support): Will convert the runbook into a persistent internal doc after kickoff and add the ingestion test plan. Keeping updates in SUP-8454.

Mira (Eng): I'll post provisioning ETA in the ticket after model confirmation. Also tagging Security for HSM guidance.

Ben (CS): Owners confirmed. Closing handoff thread - keep updates in SUP-8454 and the onboarding calendar.
